items.title: 1990年代末〜2000年代の日本ゲーム文化を収めた写真300点超が無料公開。当時のTGS，AMショーなどの模様に加えて，秋葉原の風景も確認できる
items.summary: ゲーム史の保存や研究に取り組む米国の非営利団体・VideoGameHistoryFoundation（VGHF）は2026年10月21日，写真コレクション「ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection」をオンラインアーカイブで公開した。1990年代末〜2000年代の日本のゲームイベントや街の風景などを収めた300点超の写真を無料で閲覧できる。

zh.title: 超过 300 张描绘 20 世纪 90 年代末至 2000 年代日本游戏文化的照片可免费获取。除了当时的TGS和AM秀之外，还可以看到秋叶原的风景。
zh.summary: 2026 年 10 月 21 日，致力于保存和研究游戏历史的美国非营利组织 VideoGameHistoryFoundation (VGHF) 在其在线档案中发布了其照片集“ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection”。您可以免费查看 300 多张 20 世纪 90 年代末至 2000 年代日本游戏活动和城市场景的照片。

en.title: Over 300 photos depicting Japanese game culture from the late 1990s to the 2000s are available for free. In addition to the TGS and AM shows from that time, you can also see the scenery of Akihabara.
en.summary: On October 21, 2026, the VideoGameHistoryFoundation (VGHF), an American non-profit organization that works to preserve and research game history, released its photo collection ``ColinWilliamsonPhotographyCollection'' on its online archive. You can view over 300 photos of Japanese gaming events and city scenes from the late 1990s to 2000s for free.

zh.title: 从网球到相扑！？隆重推出“Nintendo Switch Sports Resort”，这是一项 Switch 2 独有的体验式运动和各种游戏。

en.title: From tennis to sumo wrestling!? Introducing ``Nintendo Switch Sports Resort'', an experiential sport and a variety of games unique to Switch 2.
en.summary: ``NintendoSwitchSportsResort'', which Nintendo released today (October 22nd), is software for NintendoSwitch2 that allows you to enjoy hands-on sports with Joy-Con2. Let's take a look at what you can do with this game, which includes exploration around a tropical island, ranking battles, and more.

items.title: 最弱ゾンビが下克上！ アートも作り手の姿勢もパンクな「ステューピッド・ネバー・ダイズ」に込めたアクションゲーム愛とは？［インタビュー］
items.summary: GPTRACK50の第1作「ステューピッド・ネバー・ダイズ」が本日発売を迎えた。最初の企画書から残ったのは……ゾンビだけ？ パンクなアートや30分で駆け抜けるゲームサイクル，奇妙で愛すべきキャラクターはどう生まれたのか。開発の道のりを3人に聞いた。

zh.title: 最弱的僵尸被打败了！ 《愚蠢不死》中对动作游戏的热爱是什么，无论是美术还是创作者的态度都是朋克的？ [面试]
zh.summary: GPTRACK50首部作品《Stupid Never Dies》今日发售。第一个提案剩下的就是……僵尸？朋克艺术、30分钟就能完成的游戏循环、奇怪又可爱的角色是如何产生的？我们向三个人询问了开发过程。

en.title: The weakest zombie is defeated! What is the love for action games that goes into "Stupid Never Dies," where both the art and the creator's attitude are punk? [Interview]
en.summary: GPTRACK50's first work ``Stupid Never Dies'' was released today. All that remained from the first proposal was... zombies? How did the punk art, the game cycle that can be completed in 30 minutes, and the strange yet endearing characters come about? We asked three people about the development process.

items.title: ネクソン，政府と組んで約263億円を投じて「下請けではなく，自立したユニコーン企業を育てる」
items.summary: 新興のゲーム開発会社に対する資本市場の冷え込みが続くなか，民間企業と韓国政府が総額2500億ウォン（約263億円）規模のファンドを組成した。初期の発掘から後続の成長まで資金を連続して供給し，韓国ゲーム産業の基礎体力を回復させるという構想だ。

zh.title: Nexon 与政府合作投资约 263 亿日元“培育独立的独角兽公司而不是分包商”
zh.summary: 随着新兴游戏开发公司的资本市场持续降温，民间企业和韩国政府组建了总额达2500亿韩元（约合263亿日元）的基金。其想法是通过从最初的发现到随后的成长不断提供资金，恢复韩国游戏产业的基本实力。

en.title: Nexon teams up with the government to invest approximately 26.3 billion yen to ``cultivate an independent unicorn company rather than a subcontractor''
en.summary: As the capital market for emerging game development companies continues to cool down, private companies and the South Korean government have formed a fund totaling 250 billion won (approximately 26.3 billion yen). The idea is to restore the basic strength of the Korean game industry by continuously providing funds from initial discovery to subsequent growth.

This time, I had the opportunity to experience it in advance, so I would like to share my impressions with you.

ja.title: 奇妙な話: ゲームを原作とした映画はゲームらしくあるべきだ
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。ロナウジーニョ先生、お身体に気をつけてください（写真／Ronaldinho） 私も『バイオハザード』シリーズのファンなので、少し前に公開された『バイオハザード：アウトブレイクナイト』も観に行きました。観終わった後、私は密かに85点、映画自体に75点、あと10点加えて「ゲームっぽい」と褒めたいと思った。もちろん、映画とゲームは異なる形式であり、相互に完全にコピーすることは非現実的です。しかし、私はいつも心の中にある考えを持っています。ゲームが映画化される場合、多くの人 (忠実なプレイヤーであっても) は登場人物やプロットが大幅に変更されると想定します。では、原作がゲームであることを他に証明できるものは何でしょうか？映画館に行くためにチケットを買うために数十ドル、さらには数百ドルを費やすプレイヤーは、決して犬の肉として売られるためにそれをしているわけではありません。そして、『バイオハザード: アウトブレイク ナイト』はそれをうまく扱っています。ゲームオリジナルの主人公を選ばず、最も古典的な背景「ラクーンシティ」を使用

en.title: Strange story: Movies adapted from games should look like games
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Teacher Ronaldinho, take care of yourself (Photo / Ronaldinho) As a fan of the "Resident Evil" series, I also went to watch "Resident Evil: Outbreak Night" which was released some time ago. After watching it, I secretly wanted to give it 85 points, 75 points for the movie itself, and an extra 10 points to praise it for being "like a game". Of course, movies and games are two different forms, and it is unrealistic to completely copy each other. But I always have a thought in my mind. When a game is adapted into a movie, many people (even loyal players) assume that the characters and plot will be significantly modified. So what else can show that the original work is a game? Players who spend tens or even hundreds of dollars to buy tickets to go to the cinema are definitely not doing it for the sake of being sold as dog meat! en.title: Exclusive interview with Jihe | "Make some good equipment that will not be easily eliminated quickly!" Chatting with the chief designer of "World of Warcraft" about the new atmosphere of World of Warcraft

Shanghai, National Exhibition and Convention Center Hall 1 in October. en.summary: "Turok: Origins" is an action shooting game developed and published by Saber Interactive. It is also a new work in the classic dinosaur hunting game series "Turok". The game brings players into a world that combines primitive ecology and science fiction elements: players will play the role of Turok warriors, traveling across multiple planets, exploring ancient ruins and strange environments, and fighting against ferocious dinosaurs and alien forces that threaten human survival. In terms of gameplay, this game retains the core features of the series with weapon combat, while adding melee attacks, special abilities and a character growth system. Players can obtain DNA from fallen enemies and the environment, unlock new abilities, and gradually strengthen the combat capabilities of the suit and themselves. The game also supports single-player play and cooperative modes with up to three people, allowing players to embark on adventures alone or face the loss with teammates.

As part of the adjustment, a new Mass Effect game that was in the early stages of development has been cancelled. Electronic Arts chief operating officer David Tinson and chief studio officer Cam Weber said in a letter to employees that the company has reviewed various businesses over the past few months and decided to cut some projects. The gaming giant went private in August following a $55 billion leveraged buyout led by a Saudi Arabian investment fund, carrying about $18 billion in debt. Previously, the company had told investors that it planned to save up to $700 million by cutting research and development costs. BioWare was founded in 1995

zh.summary: 2026年10月21日，OpenAI宣布使用数千个AI智能体在短短32分钟内分析了从数百万只小鼠脑细胞获得的实验数据，发现了新的线索，这将导致对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等的研究。他们在短时间内完成了人类研究人员需要几个月到一年的分析，还提出了迄今为止可能被忽视的基因功能的新假设。阅读更多...

en.title: Thousands of AIs analyze data from millions of brain cells in just 32 minutes, discovering new clues for research into Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases
en.summary: On October 21, 2026, OpenAI announced that it used thousands of AI agents to analyze experimental data obtained from millions of mouse brain cells in just 32 minutes, and discovered new clues that will lead to research on Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, etc. They conducted an analysis in a short time that would have taken human researchers from several months to a year, and also proposed a new hypothesis about the function of genes that may have been overlooked until now. read more...

items.title: Node.jsがセキュリティアップデートで「22.23.4」「24.22.1」「26.12.1」配信、全体で10件の脆弱性を修正
items.summary: オープンソースのJavaScript実行環境「Node.js」が脆弱性10件に対応するセキュリティアップデートを行いました。今回のアップデートはスケジュール通り公開されたもので、修正される脆弱性の深刻度は4件が「高」、3件が「中」、3件が「低」となっています。続きを読む...

zh.title: Node.js 发布安全更新“22.23.4”、“24.22.1”和“26.12.1”，共修复 10 个漏洞
zh.summary: 开源JavaScript执行环境“Node.js”已更新，修复了10个漏洞。此更新已按计划发布，其修复的漏洞的严重性为“高”（4）、“中”（3）、“低”（3）。阅读更多...

en.title: Node.js releases security updates ``22.23.4'', ``24.22.1'', and ``26.12.1'', fixing 10 vulnerabilities in total
en.summary: The open source JavaScript execution environment "Node.js" has been updated to address 10 vulnerabilities. This update was released as scheduled, and the severity of the vulnerabilities it fixes is ``high'' for 4, ``medium'' for 3, and ``low'' for 3. read more...

items.title: 国連機関が「パリ協定の1.5℃目標はもはや実現不可能」と指摘
items.summary: 2015年のパリ協定では、2020年以降の気候変動問題に対する国際的枠組みとして、「世界共通の長期目標として世界的な平均気温上昇を産業革命以前に比べて2℃より十分低く保つとともに、1.5℃に抑える努力を追求すること」が合意されました。2026年現在、この「1.5℃」という目標はもはや実現不可能であると、国連機関の1つ・国連環境計画が指摘しています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 联合国机构指出“巴黎协定1.5℃目标不再可实现”
zh.summary: 2015年《巴黎协定》是2020年起应对气候变化问题的国际框架，一致同意“共同的长期目标是使全球平均气温较工业革命前水平上升远低于2摄氏度，并努力将全球平均气温上升限制在1.5摄氏度”。截至2026年，联合国机构之一的联合国环境规划署已指出，这一1.5摄氏度的目标已经无法实现。阅读更多...

en.title: UN agency points out that ``Paris Agreement's 1.5℃ target is no longer achievable''
en.summary: In the 2015 Paris Agreement, an international framework for dealing with climate change issues from 2020 onwards, it was agreed that ``a common long-term goal is to keep the global average temperature rise well below 2 degrees Celsius compared to pre-industrial revolution levels, and to pursue efforts to limit the rise in global average temperatures to 1.5 degrees Celsius''. As of 2026, the United Nations Environment Program, one of the United Nations agencies, has pointed out that this goal of 1.5 degrees Celsius is no longer achievable. read more...

items.title: 「ロボットの赤ちゃん」で育児のシミュレーションをするだけでカップルのテストステロン値に変化が生じる
items.summary: 男性ホルモンともいわれるテストステロンは、実のところ男性に限らず女性の体内でも産生されており、筋肉や骨量の増加といった身体的変化を引き起こすほか、攻撃性や競争的な行動にも関連しています。「ロボットの赤ちゃん人形」で育児のシミュレーションを行ったカップルでは、そんなテストステロンの値が変化するという研究結果が報告されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 一对夫妇的睾丸激素水平仅仅通过模拟“机器人婴儿”的育儿过程就会发生变化
zh.summary: 睾丸激素，也称为男性激素，实际上不仅男性也会产生，女性也会产生，除了引起肌肉和骨质增加等身体变化外，它还与攻击性和竞争性行为有关。一项研究报告称，使用机器人娃娃模拟抚养孩子的夫妇的睾丸激素水平发生了变化。阅读更多...

en.title: A couple's testosterone levels change just by simulating childcare with a "robot baby"
en.summary: Testosterone, also known as the male hormone, is actually produced not only in men but also in women, and in addition to causing physical changes such as increased muscle and bone mass, it is also associated with aggressive and competitive behavior. A study reported that the testosterone levels of couples who simulated raising children using a robot baby doll changed. read more...

items.title: 月面で初のスーパーコンピューター性能テストをHPEとNASAが計画、AIによる地形解析やサイバー攻撃検知も実施へ
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise(HPE)が2026年10月20日、月面で高性能コンピューティング(HPC)の性能測定やAIの動作実験を実施する計画を発表しました。2026年後半に打ち上げ予定の月面探査機に小型コンピューター「HPE Spaceborne Computer-4」を搭載し、月面でのデータ処理技術の実用性を検証します。続きを読む...

zh.title: HPE 和 NASA 计划在月球上进行首次超级计算机性能测试，包括使用人工智能进行地形分析和网络攻击检测
zh.summary: 2026年10月20日，惠普企业（HPE）宣布计划在月球表面进行高性能计算（HPC）性能测量和AI运行实验。小型计算机HPE星载计算机4号将安装在计划于2026年下半年发射的月球表面探测器上，以验证月球表面数据处理技术的实用性。阅读更多...

en.title: HPE and NASA plan first supercomputer performance test on the moon, including topographical analysis and cyber attack detection using AI
en.summary: On October 20, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) announced plans to conduct high-performance computing (HPC) performance measurements and AI operation experiments on the lunar surface. A small computer, the HPE Spaceborne Computer-4, will be installed on a lunar surface probe scheduled to launch in the second half of 2026 to verify the practicality of data processing technology on the lunar surface. read more...
